name: xcf-concordium-facilitator
description: **XCF Consists of:** - **UFX (Universal Facilitator for x402):** rail-agnostic core that exposes the x402-friendly API, enforces idempotency/expiry, orchestrates policy checks, signs verifiable receipts (JWS), and emits webhooks/metrics. - **CRP (Concordium Rail Plugin):** rail-specific adapter that reads **finalized** Concordium PLT (protocol-level token) events via gRPC v2 and matches exact payments.

scripts.schema:check: ajv compile --spec=draft2020 -c ajv-formats -s schemas/challenge.schema.json && ajv compile --spec=draft2020 -c ajv-formats -s schemas/receipt.schema.json
